summary: Mental Hospital IV, a survival horror.
description: Mental Hospital IV – a first-person survival horror game with stunning graphics and an atmosphere brimming with terror. Dive into the ambiance of genuine horror, but remember: playing alone in the dark will give you the ultimate scare experience. If your mind craves unconventional challenges and your nerves seek an adrenaline rush, then "Mental Hospital IV" by "AGaming+" will shake you to your core! Turn off the lights, plug in your headphones, and brace yourself for the unpredictable. Only your attentiveness and wit will help you escape the claws of the nightmare. Our story continues the events narrated in Mental Hospital III. The protagonist remains in pursuit of the mysteries of the enigmatic St. Peter's Hospital. When the police stand idle and major newspapers remain silent, one call can change everything. This time you'll face even greater horrors, and what you'll witness will stay with you forever. Reasons to download Mental Hospital IV right now: → Encounter a plethora of terrifying monsters and beasts. → Navigate through diverse levels. → The video camera allows you to see even in pitch darkness. → Engaging and unpredictable storyline. → Exceptional graphics tailored for mobile devices. → A game without in-app purchases. → The ultimate horror gameplay blend: frightful monsters, sudden chills, and a spine-tingling atmosphere.
